role: shadow: published and reviewed daily next to fondo-v2, which remains the reference fund; no one is asked to trade it
base: fondo-v2: VTI/VXUS 60/40 inside equity, AGG, 5% cash, 5 pp drift rebalancing, other engine tilts disabled
equity_share: clip(0.70 * sigma_bar / sigma, 0.60, 0.90) from the gate test rule; bonds = 0.95 - equity; cash = 0.05

volatility.daily_market_returns: Kenneth French Mkt-RF + RF until the last archived day, then VTI adjusted-close returns from the market snapshot
volatility.sigma: sqrt(252) * EWMA daily volatility, lambda 0.94, at the last session of the previous calendar month
volatility.sigma_bar: mean of sigma at every earlier month end since 1963-07
volatility.update: the target changes only when a new calendar month starts

rebalancing: trade back to the current target when any sleeve deviates more than 5 pp from it
comparison_with_fondo_v2: same inception, capital, prices and costs; reported side by side from the first common review
promotion_rule: fondo-v3 can replace fondo-v2 only by a new registration after at least 12 monthly targets, reporting its live Sharpe and drawdown against fondo-v2; no earlier switch
